format: FLAC, 48 kHz, stereo, 24-bit; sample peak -3 dBFS; one-shots keep 50 ms before the first onset; no reverb and no EQ unless `processed` says so
onsets: All times are seconds from the start of the file. onsets_s: for a one-shot, its first sound (the first 1 ms within 40 dB of the peak), which the cut puts at 0.05 s; loud_onset_s is where it comes within 20 dB of its peak, the better mark for sync when the two differ, and loud_until_s where it has fallen 26 dB. For a file of several events, onsets_s are their loud onsets and `events` gives each with its peak, its end and how it is judged when cut out alone (from 30 ms before its onset to 30 ms before the next). peak_at_s is the loudest sample; loudest_400ms_at_s the stretch a mix is levelled by. Beds have no onsets.
earshot_rule: pass = the description beats every alternative in earshot's forced choice (p_vs_alts) and is 'strong' (z >= 3 among earshot's vocabulary) or holds at least 60% of the choice and 2x the best alternative (sound.md section 4). A fail is evidence, not a veto: the ear decides.
cost: nothing: Stable Audio 3.0 Small SFX on this machine's CPU and earshot's catalogue; no paid service
nobody_has_heard_these: pass and fail are a listening model's reading, not an ear
